I've stopped buying regular batteries (AA, AAA, etc...) anywhere but Amazon.For the price, these are unbeatable for standard alkaline batteries.Especially with toddler toys....batteries come and go, fast.

When using these batteries in a professional camera flash (high powered device) they last only 3/4 as long as a similar duracell or energizer battery but for the difference in price I recommend these. In something like an xbox controller (low power device) they seem to last just as long.
It's not a high discharge battery, but for typical uses such wireless mouse and flashlights, these are great.
For years I purchased regular brand name batteries from local retailers. As these seemed to be a deal I purchased a pack. They seem to work just as well as the name-brands, just at a cheaper cost.

Found these here before Christmas, and decided to order for our children's toys that required batteries. Can't beat the price for the amount you get, they work as expected, and long lasting. In my opinion the box they come in is extremely convenient compared to other battery packaging.
